To those who know the LORD I speak
To those who know the LORD I speak,
The bridegroom of my soul I seek,
No line of this stanza quotes a verse closely; it is the hymn's own confession.
Cowper printed the hymn under Song of Songs 5:8. The line that comes closest to it is marked.
O daughters of Jerusalem, I adjure you, if you find my beloved, tell him I am sick with love. SONG OF SONGS 5:8 · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ SONG OF SONGS 5
Such JESUS is, and such his grace, Oh may he shine on you! And tell him, when you see his face, I long to see him too. STANZA VI
